_comment: PIPE54 limits on `<stem>.summary.json`, generated by scripts/gen_contract_fixtures.py from schemas.MeetingSummary.model_json_schema(); do not hand-edit. `mp publish` validates the file against the schema before any sink runs, so a Swift writer (the Summary editor, the Apple summarizer) that exceeds one fails every later publish of that meeting. Swift mirrors these as MeetingSummary.titleMaxLength, summaryMaxItems and confidenceValues (SummaryLimitsTests).
